name: Mercure Hai Phong
short_description: A 176-room hotel plus 57 serviced apartments in central Hai Phong on Lach Tray Street, with most rooms offering city views.
ai_summary: Mercure Hai Phong combines 176 standard guest rooms with 57 fully-equipped serviced apartments on Lach Tray Street in Hai Phong's central business district, positioned by local coverage as one of the city's first international hotels. Most rooms offer city views given the property's central location, and it functions as a base for both business travelers and visitors combining a Hai Phong stop with trips to Ha Long Bay or Cat Ba. Guest reviews are consistently positive, describing the hotel as modern and clean with a strong range of facilities -- spa, gym, lounge, and a well-regarded rooftop pool -- alongside friendly, helpful staff and a varied breakfast.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Hai Phong have serviced apartments?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 176 standard guest rooms, the property includes 57 fully-equipped serviced apartments on Lach Tray Street in central Hai Phong, giving longer-stay guests a self-catering option within the same hotel.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Hai Phong a good base for visiting Ha Long Bay?
faqs.answer: Yes -- its central Hai Phong location works well for travelers combining a city stop with day trips or transfers toward Ha Long Bay or Cat Ba Island, both within reach of northern Vietnam's main coastal attractions.
